import mujoco, numpy as np, time, itertools

base = open('model_ref.xml').read()
FULL = mujoco.mjtState.mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS

def build(xml, name):
    p = '/tmp/%s.xml' % name
    open(p,'w').write(xml)
    return mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(p)

def sim(m, seed, T=2.0):
    d = mujoco.MjData(m)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=d.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    n = int(T / m.opt.timestep)
    for _ in range(n):
        mujoco.mj_step(m, d)
    s = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(m, FULL))
    mujoco.mj_getState(m, d, s, FULL)
    return s, d

seeds = (0, 1)
ref = build(base, 'ref')
refstates = {}
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for s in seeds:
    refstates[s], _ = sim(ref, s)
tref = (time.perf_counter()-t0)/len(seeds)
print('ref  avg_time=%.4f  nq=%d nv=%d neq=%d nefc=%d' % (tref, ref.nq, ref.nv, ref.neq, refstates[seeds[0]][1].nefc))

def opt(xml, opts):
    return xml.replace('<compiler autolimits="true"/>', '<compiler autolimits="true"/>\n  <option %s/>' % opts)

variants = {}
variants['base'] = base
for it in (20, 10, 5, 2, 1):
    variants['it%d' % it] = opt(base, 'iterations="%d"' % it)
variants['jac_dense'] = opt(base, 'jacobian="dense"')
variants['solverCG'] = opt(base, 'solver="CG"')
variants['solverPGS'] = opt(base, 'solver="PGS"')
variants['warm_off'] = base.replace('<compiler autolimits="true"/>',
    '<compiler autolimits="true"/>\n  <option><flag warmstart="disable"/></option>')
variants['contact_off'] = base.replace('<compiler autolimits="true"/>',
    '<compiler autolimits="true"/>\n  <option><flag contact="disable"/></option>')
variants['it10_dense'] = opt(base, 'iterations="10" jacobian="dense"')
variants['it5_dense'] = opt(base, 'iterations="5" jacobian="dense"')
variants['tol1e4'] = opt(base, 'tolerance="1e-4"')

print('%-14s %8s %6s %9s %9s %5s' % ('variant','time','ratio','maxabs','norm','nefc'))
for name, xml in variants.items():
    m = build(xml, name)
    ts, diffs = [], []
    for s in seeds:
        t0 = time.perf_counter(); st, d = sim(m, s); ts.append(time.perf_counter()-t0)
        diffs.append(st - refstates[s])
    t = np.mean(ts)
    print('%-14s %8.4f %6.2f %9.2e %9.2e %5d' % (name, t, t/tref,
          max(np.abs(x).max() for x in diffs), max(np.linalg.norm(x) for x in diffs), d.nefc))

# breakdown of constraint cost vs nefc
m = ref; d = mujoco.MjData(m); mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
print('nefc at t=0:', d.nefc, ' ncon:', d.ncon)
for name in ('mj_makeConstraint','mj_projectConstraint','mj_referenceConstraint','mj_fwdConstraint'):
    fn = getattr(mujoco, name, None)
    if fn is None: continue
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(300): fn(m, d)
    print('%-24s %8.1f us' % (name, (time.perf_counter()-t0)/300*1e6))

import mujoco, numpy as np, time

    p = '/tmp/%s.xml' % name

def sim(m, seed, T=2.0):
    d = mujoco.MjData(m)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=d.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    n = int(T / m.opt.timestep)
    for _ in range(n):
        mujoco.mj_step(m, d)
    s = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(m, FULL))
    mujoco.mj_getState(m, d, s, FULL)
    return s, d

seeds = (0, 1)
ref = build(base, 'ref')
refstates = {}
tre = []
for s in seeds:
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); st, dref = sim(ref, s); tre.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    refstates[s] = st

print('ref   time=%.4f s  nefc=%d  niter=%s  nv=%d' % (tref, dref.nefc, list(dref.solver_niter), ref.nv))

def run(name, mut):
    m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('/app/model_ref.xml')
    mut(m)
    ts, diffs = [], []
    for s in seeds:
        t0 = time.perf_counter(); st, d = sim(m, s); ts.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
        diffs.append(st - refstates[s])
    t = float(np.mean(ts))
    mx = max(np.abs(x).max() for x in diffs)
    ok = all(np.allclose(st, refstates[s], atol=1e-5) for s, st in zip(seeds, [None, None])) if False else None
    print('%-22s %7.4f  ratio=%.2f  maxabs=%.2e  ok=%s  niter=%s' %
          (name, t, t / tref, mx,
           all(np.allclose(st, refstates[s], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5) for s, st in zip(seeds, [sim(m, s)[0] for s in seeds])) if False else '',
           list(d.solver_niter)))
    return t, mx, diffs

cases = []
cases.append(('it50', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 50)))
cases.append(('it20', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 20)))
cases.append(('it10', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 10)))
cases.append(('it5',  lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 5)))
cases.append(('it2',  lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 2)))
cases.append(('tol1e-6', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'tolerance', 1e-6)))
cases.append(('tol1e-5', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'tolerance', 1e-5)))
cases.append(('tol1e-4', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'tolerance', 1e-4)))
cases.append(('jacdense', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'jacobian', mujoco.mjtJacobian.mjJAC_DENSE)))
cases.append(('solverPGS', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'solver', mujoco.mjtSolver.mjSOL_PGS)))
cases.append(('solverCG', lambda m: setattr(m.opt, 'solver', mujoco.mjtSolver.mjSOL_CG)))
cases.append(('dense+it30', lambda m: (setattr(m.opt, 'jacobian', mujoco.mjtJacobian.mjJAC_DENSE), setattr(m.opt, 'iterations', 30))))
cases.append(('contactoff', lambda m: m.opt.disableflags.__ior__(mujoco.mjtDisableBit.mjDSBL_CONTACT)))

res = {}
for name, mut in cases:
    res[name] = run(name, mut)

print()
print('--- accuracy check vs ref (atol=rtol=1e-5) ---')
for name, mut in cases:
    m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('/app/model_ref.xml'); mut(m)
    good = True
    for s in seeds:
        st, _ = sim(m, s)
        if not np.allclose(st, refstates[s], atol=1e-5):
            good = False
    print('%-22s allclose=%s' % (name, good))

import mujoco, numpy as np, time, sys

base = open('/app/model_ref.xml').read()
FULL = mujoco.mjtState.mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS

def build(xml, name):
    p = '/tmp/%s.xml' % name
    open(p, 'w').write(xml)
    return mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(p)

def sim(m, seed, T=2.0, trace=False):
    d = mujoco.MjData(m)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    d.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=d.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    n = int(T / m.opt.timestep)
    maxcon = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        mujoco.mj_step(m, d)
        if trace and d.ncon > maxcon:
            maxcon = d.ncon
    s = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(m, FULL))
    mujoco.mj_getState(m, d, s, FULL)
    return s, d, maxcon

def opt(xml, opts):
    return xml.replace('<compiler autolimits="true"/>',
        '<compiler autolimits="true"/>\n  <option %s/>' % opts)

variants = {
  'ref':            base,
  'dense':          opt(base, 'jacobian="dense"'),
  'densePGS':       opt(base, 'jacobian="dense" solver="PGS"'),
  'denseCG':        opt(base, 'jacobian="dense" solver="CG"'),
  'sparsePGS':      opt(base, 'solver="PGS"'),
  'densePGS_nocontact': opt(base, 'jacobian="dense" solver="PGS"').replace(
        '<compiler autolimits="true"/>',
        '<compiler autolimits="true"/>\n  <option jacobian="dense" solver="PGS"><flag contact="disable"/></option>'),
}

seeds = list(range(12))
models = {k: build(v, k) for k, v in variants.items()}

# reference states + contact statistics
refstates = {}
maxcon_ref = 0
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for s in seeds:
    st, d, mc = sim(models['ref'], s, trace=True)
    refstates[s] = st
    maxcon_ref = max(maxcon_ref, mc)
tref = (time.perf_counter() - t0) / len(seeds)
print('ref: avg 2s-sim time = %.4fs, max ncon during sim = %d, nbody=%d neq=%d nv=%d' %
      (tref, maxcon_ref, models['ref'].nbody, models['ref'].neq, models['ref'].nv))

print('%-20s %8s %7s %11s %11s' % ('variant', 'time', 'ratio', 'maxabs', 'norm'))
summary = {}
for k, m in models.items():
    if k == 'ref':
        continue
    ts, dmax, dnorm = [], 0.0, 0.0
    bad = []
    for s in seeds:
        t0 = time.perf_counter(); st, d, mc = sim(m, s); ts.append(time.perf_counter()-t0)
        diff = st - refstates[s]
        dmax = max(dmax, np.abs(diff).max()); dnorm = max(dnorm, np.linalg.norm(diff))
        if not np.allclose(st, refstates[s], atol=1e-5):
            bad.append((s, np.abs(diff).max()))
    t = float(np.mean(ts))
    summary[k] = (t, dmax)
    print('%-20s %8.4f %7.3f %11.2e %11.2e  failseeds=%s' % (k, t, t/tref, dmax, dnorm, bad[:3]))
